strings.zh: 这感觉真是神奇,{NEWLINE}只要旅途上{SCROLL}有自己的精灵做伴,{NEWLINE}就不会觉得厌倦。{SCROLL}带上你的精灵{NEWLINE}去四处走走吧！{SCROLL}如果你有心{NEWLINE}和自己的精灵聊聊,{SCROLL}或许会有意想不到的收获！

strings.en: How are your Pokémon doing? Talk with{NEWLINE}them lots...{SCROLL}Huh? That Pokémon is holding a leaf...{SCROLL}Could that be a Shiny Leaf?!{SCROLL}Legend has it that only Pokémon with a{NEWLINE}deep bond with people can find these.{CLEAR}The legend also says...{SCROLL}If you gather five of these leaves, you{NEWLINE}can make a beautiful crown...{SCROLL}Wonderful! That’s just like you!{SCROLL}If you find another Shiny Leaf, please{NEWLINE}bring it to show me!
